item.description:
Version 1.8 November 24, 2026 · build 166

  • Skip Intro: during an episode's opening titles, a Skip Intro button appears at the bottom right of the picture and jumps to where the episode begins, on the Mac, iPad, iPhone, Apple TV and Vision Pro and in the web client, in 3D too. On the Apple TV it has the focus, so one click skips.
  • Next Episode: during the end credits, Next Episode plays the show's next unwatched episode, as reaching the end does.
  • The server finds a season's intro and credits the first time one of its episodes plays, by comparing it with the next episode, then finds them in the season's other episodes, earlier and later, in the background. The first time, the button appears a few seconds into the intro; after that, as soon as the episode starts. Only seasons you play are looked at, a few seconds of video for each episode, so the library's disks aren't kept busy. Settings › Storage shows what's been found.
  • Skip to End: during the end credits of a show's last episode, where there's no next episode to go on to, Skip to End finishes the episode, as reaching the end does.
  • Mac: once the player's controls fade away, they no longer leave an empty grey panel over the picture and the subtitles.
  • Subtitles in the web client and at the smaller video sizes are read afresh when an episode's file is replaced (with new subtitles, say), rather than the old ones being kept until the server restarts.
  • Web client: a video that fails is loaded afresh again, up to five times, as before 1.7 (since 1.7 it gave up after the first failure).
